name: Shin Sangoku M*sou
source:
The Sengoku era, it is a period where the power rules everything.
So take control of the defeated female warriors!
Do what you like to them to satisfy your desire!

Adventure game based on "Dynas*y Warriors."

Strong female warriors from volume 1 to 4 of the series are featured in this work.
They are now in the hands of ordinary soldiers, enemies, ex-subordinates.

If I were there to beat the female warrior... this is a work to satisfy that delusion!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ050071.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
战国时代是强者为王的年代。
支配战败的女武将吧！随心所欲地对待她们，满足你的欲望！

这是一款以《真·三国无双》为基础的冒险游戏。

本作收录了系列第1至第4作中的强力女武将。如今，她们落入普通士兵、敌人或前部下手中。

“要是我也能打倒那些女武将……”本作正是为了满足这种妄想！

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ050071.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
